description: This file implements the 'WidevinePlatformDRM' class, which handles DRM decryption operations for Widevine. It includes methods for constructing and destructing the platform, and for decrypting media data using handle-based identifiers, with support for session-specific decryption. It also references external functions and classes related to Widevine's Cdm interface and a utility for handle conversion.

classes.name: WidevinePlatformDRM
classes.description: A class providing Widevine DRM platform functionalities including decryption methods, constructor, and destructor.

methods.name: WidevinePlatformDRM(widevine::Cdm * cdm)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Widevine platform DRM object with a pointer to the Widevine CDM.

methods.name: ~WidevinePlatformDRM()
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup of the Widevine platform DRM object.

methods.name: widevine::Cdm::Status decryptWithHandle(int32_t handle,const std::string & session_id,const widevine::Cdm::DecryptionBatch & batch)
methods.description: Performs decryption using a handle and a decryption batch; converts handle to secure memory and invokes the underlying decrypt function.

methods.name: decryptWithHandle (session_id version)
methods.description: Performs session-specific decryption using a handle, session ID, and a decryption batch; converts handle to secure memory and uses the session ID for decryption.
